# meow-config 0.22.0

Vendored without a version change from the crates.io meow-config 0.22.0 source.
Upstream: https://github.com/meow-rs/meow-rs . The upstream MIT license is
retained in LICENSE, matching the other vendored 0.22.0 packages.

Paws adds explicit per-load provider network policy and runtime-owned provider
observation. These hooks must not install process-wide offline policy or
attribute a retired provider update to a replacement VPN session.
